attempts.summary: Configured daily logrotate for /var/log/inventory/app.log on node1 (Alpine), keeping 7 compressed rotations via copytruncate so the application keeps writing to the same path/inode after rotation. Installed logrotate, added /etc/logrotate.d/inventory, enabled+started crond (was stopped) so /etc/periodic/daily actually fires. Verified rotation behavior with a forced run, then restarted node1 and confirmed persistence and recovery.
